notes: Notebook 06 characterises the fine-tuned model's TEST errors by reading nb05_test_probabilities_finetuned.csv (no re-inference on TEST anywhere in this notebook), joined to image_flags.csv on basename (join verified exact and complete: 3589/3589 rows matched). BlazeFace-confidence stratification used 10 bins (Spearman rho=nan vs correctness); pixel-intensity stratification (read directly from raw TEST pixels, not a model inference) used 10 bins (Spearman rho=0.0681). Brightness-confound check on 1332 misclassified TEST samples: 0.5150 fraction closer to the predicted class's brightness profile than the true class's (delta vs 0.5 null: +0.0150); this is correlational only, not causal, and confounded with expression content in the source photography. Calibration: ECE=0.3006 over 10 bins, no threshold selected. Grad-CAM (the only re-inference in this notebook, run on VALIDATION only, never TEST) located the last conv layer at runtime ('out_relu'), averaged heatmaps per class (up to 100 correctly-classified VAL samples/class), correct-vs-incorrect (pooled), and the fear/sad confusion triad (fear-as-sad n=84, small-sample caveat=False). Two review_-prefixed plots with identifiable faces were produced for supervisor review only and are not for git. FER-2013 carries no demographic labels; no demographic attribute was inferred anywhere in this notebook - this is documented as an unresolvable external-validity constraint for Sri Lankan deployment (see docs/ml/01_dataset_exploration_findings.md).
